description: A possible Late Iron Age 'shrine' site defined by a series of gullies possibly enclosing a space used for multiple animal and coin depositions. Famously this include a broken cow knee-bone full of Iron Age coins. All of these features lie within a larger series banks and ditches. Coin evidence is used to provide a broad Late Iron Age date.
bibliography: Allen, Martyn, Tom Brindle, Alex Smith, Julian D Richards, Tim Evans, Neil Holbrook, Michael Fulford, and Nathan Blick. “The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: An Online Resource.” Archaeology Data Service, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
Dennis, and Faulkner. The Sedgeford Hoard Tempus, 2005.
